antigens.title: #41 Off-by-one in slice end
antigens.pattern: Using slice(start, start + n - 1) instead of slice(start, start + n), dropping the last item of every page

antigens.title: #57 Missing null guard on nested customer field
antigens.pattern: Reading a nested object property without an optional-chaining guard, crashing when the intermediate object is undefined or null

antigens.title: #63 Float money math
antigens.pattern: Summing currency values as IEEE 754 floats, causing rounding drift; fix is integer-cent accumulation

mutants.title: Remove Math.round from refundTotal — float drift reintroduced
mutants.description: Removes per-item integer rounding from refundTotal; fractional amounts accumulate as floats, reintroducing the #63 drift bug.

mutants.title: Remove optional chaining from refundContact — crashes on missing contact
mutants.description: Removes the ?. guard so refundContact throws TypeError when customer.contact is undefined or null, reintroducing the #57 crash bug.
